proposal.reason: The substantive change is to contribution/review workflow policy and automation: reviewer routing and required-approval logic were redesigned in .github/scripts/review_automation.py and .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py, workflow wiring was reorganized via new/renamed review-*.yml pipelines, and squash-preview/commit-attribution enforcement was updated in .github/scripts/commit_message_squash.py and commit_attribution.py. Runtime PCCL modules are not changed.
